text:
maria suarez: Heads up — hourly usage charts for prod cluster show a ~2.5–3h gap starting ~2026-03-17T01:00Z. Console shows flatlines then big spikes when the ingest catches up. Affected ~12 tenants. https://console.redwood.ai/analytics/usage
support-bot: alert: ingest_consumer_lag (usage-ingest-prod) > 50k for 00:45
kevin li: on it. any errors in ETL logs? can you paste the consumer lag and PG write failures?
maria suarez: tail of etl logs: ```ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint \"hourly_rollups_pkey\" at 2026-03-17T04:21:12Z
WARN: commit failed for partition 7 offset 12456789 - Retrying
```
Also consumer lag snapshot: group usage-ingest-prod lag: 0 -> 120k -> 0 around the gap window.
daniel chen: that duplicate key could be from a partial reingest race — did we run any reingest job last night? I don't see scheduled runs.
alyssa park: Checked scheduled jobs: none. I do see a manual run by "ingest-runner" at 01:15 UTC in ci-prod. @kevin li did you run anything ad-hoc?
kevin li: I kicked a small adhoc stream replay for a single tenant at 01:18 to test retention, but not a multi-tenant job. The replay client had an offset-commit bug: when a write failed it double-committed the offset on retry, which could produce duplicate attempts and some writes get rolled back by PG. Investigating.
maria suarez: We see hourly_rollups timestamp holes for tenants A, B, C — charts show those hours missing then filled later when consumer replayed, causing the 3h delay in dashboard metrics.
daniel chen: Proposed plan: 1) Stop any adhoc replays. 2) Run a targeted safe reingest that dedups by (tenant_id, hour) using upsert. 3) Patch replay client offset handling. 4) Postmortem. Can someone run the safe reingest for the affected tenants? Concerned about doubling compute.
kevin li: Agree. Running safe reingest now for affected_tenants. Command I'm using: ```./tools/reingest_safe.sh --tenants A,B,C --start 2026-03-17T01:00Z --end 2026-03-17T04:00Z``` Monitoring PG conflict logs and consumer progress.
support-bot: scheduled reingest job created: reingest-job-195210 for tenants A,B,C. ETA ~22m.
alyssa park: I'll put a console banner and customer note about delayed usage graphs and that we're actively restoring data. Adding tags: #inc-usage-delay #priority-high.
daniel chen: If dup errors persist switch to upsert path. Also increase consumer commit timeout to avoid the double-commit race.
kevin li: Update: reingest started, switched to upsert mode, no new duplicate key errors so far. Hourly rollups are backfilling; should be visible in console within ~25-30m. Watching write throughput and PG locks.
maria suarez: Thanks — after reingest finishes I'll run a quick regression check: `SELECT count(*) FROM hourly_rollups WHERE tenant_id='A' AND hour='2026-03-17T02:00:00Z'` and compare to raw events. I'll post results here.
daniel chen: Follow-ups: kevin - patch replay client (CR #2048), daniel - add canary for manual replays, alyssa - customer comms. I'll file an incident ticket and draft a short postmortem once we have the full timeline.
kevin li: noted, I'll push the client fix to staging and include a test that simulates intermittent PG failures to ensure we don't double-commit.
maria suarez: current status: console shows partial backfill progress (~60% of affected hours restored). Will update when complete. :thumbsup:
